resume.title: Resume
resume.description: PDF resume file used for job applications

credentials.title: Account Credentials
credentials.description: Used for creating accounts on external ATS platforms during applications. Stored locally in plaintext. Prefer using SSO (Sign in with LinkedIn/Google) when possible.

agent.title: Agent Settings
agent.maxFailuresDesc: Agent stops trying after this many consecutive failures on a single job.

telemetry.title: Privacy & Telemetry
telemetry.description: Optional and off by default. If enabled, LangHire sends anonymous usage events and crash reports. It never sends your resumes, profile data, job data or API keys.

blockedDomains.title: Blocked Domains
blockedDomains.description: Jobs on these domains will be automatically skipped.

plugins.title: Job Source Plugins
plugins.description: Manage job source plugins. Built-in plugins provide LinkedIn, Indeed, SEEK, Naukri, Reed, and StepStone. Import community plugins (.yaml files) for additional job sites.
plugins.tampered: Changed since you approved it — re-import to review
plugins.tamperedToggle: This plugin's file changed since you approved it. Import it again to review it before enabling.
plugins.changedDuringReview: The file changed while you were reviewing it. Review the new version below and install again.

review.title: Review plugin before installing
review.description: Community plugins tell the AI agent what to do on a job site. Only install plugins you trust.
review.name: Plugin
review.author: Author

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface Language
language.description: Choose the language for the application interface. Set to 'Auto' to match your selected country.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.retentionDescription: Older agent conversation logs are deleted automatically. Choose "Don't save" to keep none.
privacy.exportDescription: Download everything LangHire stores about you as a JSON file.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your profile, resumes, jobs, logs, settings and API keys stored by LangHire on this computer. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Are you sure? This permanently deletes all your LangHire data and restarts the setup wizard.
privacy.deleteFailed: Could not delete your data. Please try again.

secrets.keychain: API keys are stored in your OS keychain.
secrets.file: No OS keychain is available, so API keys and passwords are stored in a file on this computer. Anyone with access to your user account could read them.

automation.title: Automation
automation.dailyApplyCap: Max applications per job site per day
automation.maxRunCost: Stop a run after this much LLM spend (USD)
automation.maxRunCostHelp: No new applications start once a run has cost this much. 0 = no limit.
automation.browserCdpUrlHelp: Use your own Chrome: start it with --remote-debugging-port=9222 and paste the address. Leave empty to use LangHire's browser.
automation.emailOtpHelp: Let the agent read the newest verification-code email in Gmail
automation.testModeHelp: The agent fills every field and clicks Submit, but the application is stopped in the browser before it is sent. Use it to check how well applications would go.

logins.title: Job site logins
logins.description: Logging in is optional. It lets the agent use your accounts on job sites; you can also add jobs by URL.
logins.none: No job sites need a login.
logins.linkedinReason: Lets the agent search LinkedIn and use Easy Apply with your account.
logins.gmailReason: The agent reads the newest verification-code email so it can enter one-time codes for you.
logins.gmailOptional: Optional. Turn on "Read verification codes from Gmail" under Automation to let the agent enter email codes for you.
logins.genericReason: Lets the agent search and apply on {{name}} with your account.
